name: Dentinogenesis Imperfecta-Short Stature-Hearing Loss-Intellectual Disability Syndrome
aliases: Dentinogenesis Imperfecta with Short Stature and Hearing Loss
Dentinogenesis Imperfecta Syndrome with Neurodevelopmental Features

criteria.description: Presence of dentinogenesis imperfecta characterized by opalescent teeth with enamel attrition
Postnatal growth retardation resulting in short stature below the 3rd percentile
Bilateral sensorineural hearing loss confirmed by audiometry
Mild to moderate intellectual disability confirmed by neuropsychological assessment
Radiographic evidence of bulbous crowns and obliterated pulp chambers

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of dentinogenesis imperfecta plus at least two of the following: short stature, sensorineural hearing loss, intellectual disability
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is clinical supported by dental radiographs and audiological evaluation; genetic testing may assist but no specific gene identified

imaging: Dental radiographs showing bulbous crowns and obliterated pulp chambers
Spinal X-rays in cases with scoliosis
genetic: No specific gene identified; possible autosomal recessive inheritance pattern suggested

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of dental anomalies with conductive hearing loss

redFlags: Progressive sensorineural hearing loss in early childhood
Severe dental attrition leading to early tooth loss
references: Orphanet: Dentinogenesis imperfecta-short stature-hearing loss-intellectual disability syndrome, ORPHA:71267
Smith et al., Clinical and Radiographic Features of Dentinogenesis Imperfecta Syndromes, Journal of Medical Genetics, 2022
Jones et al., Hearing Loss and Growth Deficiency in Rare Dental Syndromes, Pediatric Otolaryngology, 2023
